important_boundary_checks: Registration date and withdrawal equality are not violations; course duration equality is outside the course.
NULL dates are not replaced with zero.
EXISTS prevents duplicated registration/course rows from multiplying temporal violation counts.
Duplicate and missing dimension keys still trigger their own BLOCK rules.
Known rule IDs cannot lower their severity in SQL output; runner rejects the result.
limits: Completion is the specified 20-rule source quality module, not all remaining statistics/UI/deployment work.
Counts for repeated source rows do not establish event ingestion errors.
Temporal EXISTS results with conflicting dimension keys are descriptive; BLOCK rules prevent treating the dimension as trustworthy.
Real-data comparison uses the existing stored quality report; independently hand-checkable tests are separately attributed to Codex.
No applicant local execution or design explanation is inferred from Codex runs.
